Updates: WR-161

#### WR-161 (update, 2026-11-04): confirmed per-case attribution

- **Confirmed:** yes, for the listed cases and measured components, conditional on traced base derivatives and the local formula.
- **Location:** `source/SMLib/src/SmOffsetSurface.cpp`, `SmOffsetSurface::EvaluatePlainOrSimple`; see existing WR-161 record.
- **Algebra:** Duvv must add Buvv and Dvvv must add Bvvv, rather than Buuv. The WR-160 mixed-normal coefficient may also contribute; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-160--addendum-2026-11-04-confirmed-case-attribution.md`.
- **Evidence and scope:** At source commit `8ec4825280f7b2f9a41fc4183d609f8a080146e9`, the native diagnostic reported 3,182 cases, 2,663 pass and 519 fail; the 518 remaining cases below contain 2,206 mismatches. The legacy counterfactual reverts all four terms as a bundle: full outputs, statuses and lengths agree with C++ at the unchanged 1e-9 relative comparator for all 518. This is not a single-term isolation or proof of C++ internals. The Rust runs used their own inputs, not C++ outputs. Pinned C++ source/header blobs match `3fd5b9548d19aa8c12c29bc9637a96d42a06f8a5`; native library hashes match historical build receipts, not a reproducible-build proof. No current integrated-head native pass is claimed. Original runner inputs are reconstructed at the source commit using `crates/difftest/src/units/surface_offset_surface.rs` and the fixture or generator seed indicated per case, with the canonical input hash as a check.

The independent high-precision local jets and this algebra, together with the bundle counterfactual, support a C++ defect for each listed case within the maintainer-authorized scope. Geometry providers, clamping, extensions and outer wrappers are not globally proved. See `plan/findings/surface.offset_surface--default-third-derivatives-diagnostic-attribution--addendum-2026-11-04-per-case-four-term-attribution.md`.
